async def act(page):
    # Fill the Project name textbox with the new title
    project_name_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    await project_name_textbox.fill('Title Wanted')
    
    # Wait for the Save changes button to become enabled (not disabled)
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save changes')
    await page.wait_for_function("""
        () => {
            const button = document.querySelector('button[name="commit"][value="Save changes"]');
            return button && !button.disabled;
        }
    """)
    
    # Click the Save changes button
    await save_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the page to reload after saving
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
